hooks.title: SEVENTIES TO EIGHTIES

beats.text: These streets lie silent after an evacuation that moved everyone in one day.
It is Pripyat, an abandoned Ukrainian city near the Chernobyl plant.
It was founded in 1970 and proclaimed a city in 1979.
An abandoned Ferris wheel looms over the empty amusement park, never opened.
Former residents returned in 2020 to mark the city's fiftieth founding anniversary.
Russian forces occupied Pripyat in February 2022, leaving in early April.
The city remains administered directly from Kyiv, not by the local raion.
